# A04-S57: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

We have moved forward, but mostly with the original proposal of making synthetic Larses in text and image corresponding to the number of Danish Larses - somewhat like Martin Larsen’s effort in Monogrammer. It seems to us to match best with ARK to have a conceptual angle. And it is, of course, as part of the investigations of why “Computer Lars” is an anagram of “Marcel Proust”.
